summary: Static inventory migration findings and existing-pack collection limits; no existing pack is changed.

revision_history.change: Record the base-pack audit and distinguish layout mismatches from calculation defects.
Partition static findings into indexed shards to satisfy the existing 1,000 KiB file-size guard; preserve every finding.

checker_scope: All Python files recursively below each package; public local definitions, public methods and explicit re-exports; literal per-file __all__ when available.
interpretation: Qualified-row matching is format-sensitive: an unqualified legacy API row can produce both a missing qualified row and an unmatched token. These are migration findings, not proof that the underlying function was added or removed.
Locators are checked against current file bounds at the code pin, not against the historical pin of an older pack.
Dynamic exports and implicit imported conveniences are outside the static inventory.
Collection failures were observed without executing cited tests; listed test files and import frames were read from main and match the worktree.
For the modified implementation-map locator target, the base-ref file bounds were read directly; the explicit correction records distinguish them from the live-file helper output.
findings_digest_scope: Canonical JSON of reconstructed static_findings, collection_findings and base_ref_bound_corrections: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, unescaped Unicode and no non-finite numbers.

base_ref_bound_corrections.basis: Base-ref file bounds; the added pack index otherwise changes this range from invalid to valid.
